rules: Strip all C and C++ comments (/* ... */ and // ...)
Rename all identifiers containing 'bad', 'good', 'G2B', 'B2G', 'FIX', 'FLAW', 'sink', 'source' (case-insensitive) to neutral names (v1, v2, ...)
Replace string literals with 'STR' and remove printLine / printIntLine argument text
Enforce unit test of zero occurrences of forbidden substrings in processed corpus
Leak check with char-3gram logistic regression: held-out accuracy must be <= 0.75

S_cwe.selection_rule: 10 CWEs chosen with seed 42 from those with >= 100 testcases
S_cwe.train_val_cwes: remaining 27 CWEs with >= 100 testcases plus smaller CWEs (80% train, 20% val by testcase)

candidate_models.J1: QWEN LR: Logistic Regression on 896-dim Qwen2.5-Coder-0.5B mean-pooled embeddings
candidate_models.J2: QWEN + static LR: Logistic Regression on [Qwen embeddings, static tool hit counts]
candidate_models.J3: LightGBM: Gradient boosted trees on [PCA-256 Qwen, static counts, length features]
candidate_models.J0_length: Length-only LR baseline: log tokens, log lines
candidate_models.J0_static: Static-only LR baseline: cppcheck, flawfinder, clang-analyze hit counts per CWE family

selection_and_tuning_rule.tuning_set: Validation partition only for each split (zero test access during tuning)
